title: Northgate Optical Late Prescription-Change Remake Waiver
content:
**Northgate Optical late prescription-change remake waiver.** A prescription-change remake opened after its free window is charged the late prescription-change remake charge, and where the remake charge booked for that remake, less every waiver already posted against it, is higher than that charge, the difference is owed back to the member and is posted as one waiver credit against that remake charge.

The waiver concerns only the remake charge of a prescription-change remake — a remake whose remake charge entry carries the prescription-change reason — and it lowers what the member owes for that remake.

## Recording the waiver: `waive_remake_overcharge_01693abf`

**Capability.** The tool waives part or all of a remake charge already booked on an eyewear job. One call adds one waiver credit against the named remake charge, with the amount given, dated today. The credit lowers what the member owes for that remake and is returned to the member's original tender. It does not earn or take back Annual Reward.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `optical_order_id` | the reference number of the eyewear job that carries the remake charge | identifier, read from the eyewear job lookup |
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member who owns the eyewear job | identifier, read from the customer profile lookup |
| `source_txn_id` | the reference number of the remake charge being waived | identifier, read from the job's charge and credit lookup |
| `remake_number` | the remake number shown on the remake charge being waived | non-negative integer: 1 for the first remake, 2 for the second, and so on |
| `remake_reason` | the reason shown on the remake charge being waived, copied from that charge | one of the values below |
| `waived_amount_usd` | the amount of the remake charge waived, in USD | plain number, no currency sign, 2 decimal places, not below 0; rounded half-to-even to 2 decimal places on booking |

Values of `remake_reason`:

- `non_adapt` — the remake was opened because the patient could not adapt to the lens design;
- `prescription_change` — opened because the prescribing doctor changed the prescription;
- `lab_defect` — opened for a lens or coating defect made by the lab;
- `frame_defect` — opened for a manufacturing defect of the frame;
- `accidental_damage` — opened to replace eyewear the patient damaged by accident;
- `not_applicable` — only for an entry that belongs to the original job rather than a remake.

**Return.** A receipt with `optical_txn_id` (the new waiver credit), `optical_order_id`, `source_txn_id` (the remake charge waived), `remake_number`, `amount` (the amount waived, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_reason` (always `remake_charge_waived`) and `status` (`posted` when the waiver is on the job's ledger).
